Dear Aabha,

Happy Birthday! 🎂 Today is yours, so make it loud, glittery and slightly dramatic, exactly the way you like it.

I won’t pretend we’re close friends who talk every day. We’re not that good friends, and that’s alright. But here’s something you should know: you’re the first stranger girl I ever talked to, and that’s something unique for me. I’ll always remember that. Some people leave a good impression without trying, and you did that. You’re sweet without being fake, calm without being boring, and somehow you carry both grace and masti in the same smile. That’s a rare combo.

Here’s my wish for the year ahead: may you be as kind to yourself as you are to everyone else. May your goals chase you for a change, your chai (or coffee) always arrive hot, and your bad days stay short and funny. Keep choosing peace, keep your laughter loud, and never shrink yourself to fit anyone’s idea of you.

And yes, you may now officially take the rest of the day off from being responsible. Eat the cake. Take the photos. Ignore the notifications you don’t like.

Once again, many many happy returns of the day. 🌸

— A friend, wishing you the very best ✨
